accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, and cards MUST include data-testid='kebab-case-name'
accessibility.contrast_enforcement: All light surfaces have min 4.5:1 text ratio (Slate-900 on White/Stone); dark surfaces have Slate-100/Slate-200 on #0B0F17 with glowing accent indicators
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full arrow and tab navigation on 9-step workflow, code viewer lines, and case study steps

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup required font packages: Variable imports for Space Grotesk, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono in frontend/src/index.css.

Implement the mixed-theme visual hierarchy: Clean, airy, modern light theme for personal introduction, philosophy, metrics, and customer empathy; Rich, dark, command-center aesthetic for the 8-step investigation case study, Lua code viewer, and live monitoring simulator.
Build interactive components with rich sample datasets reflecting Shanu Abhishek's authentic enterprise experience in Teamcenter PLM support, automation, scripting, and developer collaboration.
Ensure every interactive element has a dedicated data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Ensure all mockups are clearly marked with subtle 'Portfolio Demonstration' or 'Simulation' badges to establish high credibility.
Include a functional resume download trigger (generating or linking to a styled PDF resume view) and quick copy email/mailto action.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and command HUDs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts human natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles with hover states, active states, and focus rings.
NEVER use generic AI emoji icons (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯). Use Lucide icons or Simple Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, step clicks, and entrance reveals.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12, py-20, py-28) to give content room to breathe.
